subject: Chemistry
subtopic: Protons, Neutrons, Isotopes, Average Atomic Mass & Subshell Configurations
text: MoEYS Grade 10 Chemistry Chapter 1: Atomic Structure (ទម្រង់អាតូម), Isotopes (អ៊ីសូតូប), and Electron Configuration (ការរៀបអេឡិចត្រុង). Covers atomic number Z, mass number A = Z + N, isotopes, average atomic mass bar{A} = sum(A_i x_i)/100, energy shells (K, L, M, N) with capacity 2n^2, subshells (s, p, d, f), and Aufbau electron configurations.

source.section: Protons, Neutrons, Isotopes, Average Atomic Mass & Subshell Configurations

metadata.topic_khmer: ទម្រង់អាតូម អ៊ីសូតូប និងការរៀបអេឡិចត្រុង
metadata.subtopic_khmer: ប្រូតុង ណឺត្រុង អ៊ីសូតូប ម៉ាសអាតូមមធ្យម និងការរៀបអេឡិចត្រុងតាមស្រទាប់រង
metadata.khmer_description: សិក្សាធាតុផ្សំនៃអាតូម លេខអាតូម Z លេខម៉ាស A អ៊ីសូតូប ម៉ាសអាតូមមធ្យម និងការរៀបអេឡិចត្រុងតាមស្រទាប់និងស្រទាប់រង។
learning_objectives: Determine protons, neutrons, and electrons in neutral atoms and ions from {}^A_Z X^q
Calculate average relative atomic mass from isotope percentage abundances
Write subshell electron configurations (1s^2 2s^2 2p^6 ...) and identify valence electrons

concepts.title: Nucleus Composition, Isotopes & Aufbau Configuration (ណ្វៃយ៉ូ អ៊ីសូតូប និងការរៀបអេឡិចត្រុង)
concepts.summary: A = Z + N; average atomic mass bar{A} = sum(A_i x_i)/100; subshells fill in order 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d.
concepts.body: An atom {}^A_Z X contains Z protons and N = A - Z neutrons in its nucleus. Isotopes have the same Z but different A. Electrons fill subshells in order of increasing energy: 1s^2 2s^2 2p^6 3s^2 3p^6 4s^2 3d^{10}.

khmer_terms.Atomic Structure & Electron Configuratio: ទម្រង់អាតូម អ៊ីសូតូប និងការរៀបអេឡិចត្រុង
khmer_terms.Protons, Neutrons, Isotopes, Average Ato: ប្រូតុង ណឺត្រុង អ៊ីសូតូប ម៉ាសអាតូមមធ្យម និងការរៀបអេឡិចត្រុងតាមស្រទាប់រង
khmer_terms.atomic number: លេខអាតូម Z
khmer_terms.valence electrons: អេឡិចត្រុងវ៉ាឡង់
khmer_terms.electron shell: ស្រទាប់អេឡិចត្រុង

formulas.name: Mass Number, Shell Capacity & Average Atomic Mass
formulas.expression: A = Z + N, \quad N_{\max}(n) = 2n^2, \quad \bar{A} = \frac{\sum A_i x_i}{100}

examples.problem: Natural chlorine consists of 75% 35Cl and 25% 37Cl. Calculate the average relative atomic mass of chlorine.
solution_steps: Step 1: Apply weighted average formula: bar{A} = (35 * 75 + 37 * 25) / 100.

exercises.prompt: Write the subshell electron configuration of Calcium (Z = 20) and state its number of valence electrons.
solution_steps: 20 electrons fill 1s^2 2s^2 2p^6 3s^2 3p^6 4s^2; outermost shell n = 4 has 2 valence electrons.
Step 1: Read atomic number Z and mass number A from nuclide symbol.
Step 2: Adjust electron count for ions (subtract q for cations X^{q+}, add |q| for anions X^{q-}).
Step 3: Fill subshells following the Aufbau principle.

common_misconceptions.text: Adding electrons instead of subtracting when forming a positive cation X^{n+}.
common_misconceptions.correction: Electrons carry negative charge, so a cation X^{n+} is formed by losing n electrons (e^- = Z - n).

subject: Chemistry
subtopic: Periods, Groups, Alkali Metals, Halogens, Atomic Radius & Electronegativity
text: MoEYS Grade 10 Chemistry Chapter 2: The Periodic Table (តារាងខួបនៃធាតុគីមី) and Periodic Trends. Covers locating Period (highest shell n) and Group (valence electrons) from electron configurations, chemical families (alkali metals IA, alkaline earth metals IIA, halogens VIIA, noble gases VIIIA), and periodic trends in atomic radius, metallic character, ionization energy, and electronegativity.

source.section: Periods, Groups, Alkali Metals, Halogens, Atomic Radius & Electronegativity

metadata.topic_khmer: តារាងខួបនៃធាតុគីមី និងបម្រែបម្រួលលក្ខណៈតាមខួប
metadata.subtopic_khmer: ខួប ក្រុម លោហធាតុអាល់កាឡាំង អាឡូសែន កាំអាតូម និងកម្រិតអេឡិចត្រូអវិជ្ជមាន
metadata.khmer_description: សិក្សារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធតារាងខួប (ខួបនិងក្រុម) គ្រួសារធាតុគីមី និងបម្រែបម្រួលកាំអាតូម ថាមពលអ៊ីយ៉ុងកម្ម និងកម្រិតអេឡិចត្រូអវិជ្ជមាន។
metadata.starter_problem: Z = 15 \; (\text{Phosphorus}), \quad \text{find Period, Group, and compare electronegativity of Si, P, S}
learning_objectives: Determine an element's Period and Group from its atomic number Z
Explain periodic trends in atomic radius, ionization energy, and electronegativity across a period and down a group

concepts.title: Locating Elements & Periodic Trends (ទីតាំងធាតុ និងបម្រែបម្រួលលក្ខណៈក្នុងតារាងខួប)
concepts.summary: Period = n_max, Group A = valence electrons; across a period radius decreases and electronegativity increases.
concepts.body: For main-group elements, the Period number equals the number of electron shells n_max and the Group number equals the number of valence electrons. Moving left to right across a period, nuclear charge increases while shell count stays constant, so atomic radius decreases and electronegativity increases.

khmer_terms.Periodic Table & Periodic Trends: តារាងខួបនៃធាតុគីមី និងបម្រែបម្រួលលក្ខណៈតាមខួប
khmer_terms.Periods, Groups, Alkali Metals, Halogens: ខួប ក្រុម លោហធាតុអាល់កាឡាំង អាឡូសែន កាំអាតូម និងកម្រិតអេឡិចត្រូអវិជ្ជមាន
khmer_terms.group: ក្រុម (ជួរឈរ)
khmer_terms.alkali metals: លោហធាតុអាល់កាឡាំង (ក្រុម IA)
khmer_terms.halogens: អាឡូសែន (ក្រុម VIIA)
khmer_terms.electronegativity: កម្រិតអេឡិចត្រូអវិជ្ជមាន

formulas.name: Period and Main-Group Coordinates from Electron Configuration

examples.problem: Element X has Z = 15. Find its Period and Group, and arrange Si (Z=14), P (Z=15), and S (Z=16) in order of increasing electronegativity.
examples.answer: Period 3, Group VA; Si < P < S
solution_steps: Step 1: Electron configuration for Z = 15 is 1s^2 2s^2 2p^6 3s^2 3p^3 (shells 2, 8, 5).
Step 2: 3 shells => Period 3; 5 valence electrons => Group VA.
Step 3: Across Period 3 from left to right, electronegativity increases: Si < P < S.

exercises.prompt: Arrange the Group IA alkali metals Li, Na, K in order of increasing atomic radius.
hints: Atomic radius increases down a group as new electron shells are added.
solution_steps: Down Group IA, shell count increases (n = 2, 3, 4), so Li < Na < K.
Step 1: Write the electron configuration of each element.
Step 2: Identify Period (n_max) and Group (valence electrons).
Step 3: Apply across-period or down-group trend rules.

common_misconceptions.text: Thinking atomic radius increases from left to right across a period because Z increases.
common_misconceptions.correction: Across a period, electrons are added to the same shell while nuclear attraction increases, pulling the shell closer and decreasing radius.

text: MoEYS Grade 10 Chemistry Chapter 3: Chemical Bonding (សម្ព័ន្ធគីមី) and Molecular Structure. Covers the octet rule, ionic bonding via electron transfer, nonpolar and polar covalent bonding via electron sharing, coordinate (dative) covalent bonds, metallic bonding, Lewis dot structures, VSEPR molecular shapes, and hydrogen bonding.

source.section: Octet Rule, Ionic, Covalent & Metallic Bonds, Lewis Structures & VSEPR

metadata.topic_khmer: សម្ព័ន្ធគីមី ទម្រង់ឡឺវីស និងប៉ូលកម្មម៉ូលេគុល
metadata.subtopic_khmer: វិធានអష్టក សម្ព័ន្ធអ៊ីយ៉ុង សម្ព័ន្ធកូវ៉ាឡង់ ទម្រង់ឡឺវីស និងធរណីមាត្រម៉ូលេគុល
metadata.khmer_description: សិក្សាវិធានអష్టក សម្ព័ន្ធអ៊ីយ៉ុង សម្ព័ន្ធកូវ៉ាឡង់ប៉ូលែនិងមិនប៉ូលែ សម្ព័ន្ធលោហៈ ទម្រង់ឡឺវីស និងធរណីមាត្រម៉ូលេគុល។
metadata.starter_problem: \text{CO}_2 \text{ and } \text{NH}_3, \quad \text{draw Lewis structures and determine molecular geometry}
learning_objectives: Classify bonds as ionic, polar covalent, or nonpolar covalent
Construct Lewis structures showing bonding pairs and lone pairs
Predict molecular geometry (linear, bent, trigonal planar, trigonal pyramidal, tetrahedral) and polarity

concepts.title: Octet Rule, Lewis Structures & Molecular Polarity (វិធានអష్టក ទម្រង់ឡឺវីស និងប៉ូលកម្មម៉ូលេគុល)
concepts.summary: Metals + nonmetals form ionic bonds; nonmetals share electron pairs in covalent bonds to complete octets.
concepts.body: Atoms react to attain 8 valence electrons (2 for H). Ionic bonds form by electron transfer between metals and nonmetals; covalent bonds form by sharing electron pairs between nonmetals. Lone pairs on the central atom repel bonding pairs, bending molecules like H2O (104.5 deg) and NH3 (107 deg).

khmer_terms.Chemical Bonding, Lewis Structures & Pol: សម្ព័ន្ធគីមី ទម្រង់ឡឺវីស និងប៉ូលកម្មម៉ូលេគុល
khmer_terms.Octet Rule, Ionic, Covalent & Metallic B: វិធានអష్టក សម្ព័ន្ធអ៊ីយ៉ុង សម្ព័ន្ធកូវ៉ាឡង់ ទម្រង់ឡឺវីស និងធរណីមាត្រម៉ូលេគុល
khmer_terms.ionic bond: សម្ព័ន្ធអ៊ីយ៉ុង
khmer_terms.covalent bond: សម្ព័ន្ធកូវ៉ាឡង់
khmer_terms.lone pair: ទ្វេអេឡិចត្រុងសេរី
khmer_terms.bonding pair: ទ្វេអេឡិចត្រុងសម្ព័ន្ធ

examples.problem: Describe the Lewis structure and geometry of CO2 and NH3.
examples.answer: CO2: O=C=O (linear, 0 lone pairs on C); NH3: 3 N-H bonds + 1 lone pair on N (trigonal pyramidal)
solution_steps: Step 1: CO2 has 4 + 2(6) = 16 valence e^- => O=C=O with two double bonds and 0 lone pairs on C (linear, nonpolar).
Step 2: NH3 has 5 + 3(1) = 8 valence e^- => N forms 3 single bonds with H and keeps 1 lone pair (trigonal pyramidal, polar).

exercises.prompt: State the bond type and chemical formula of the compound formed between Calcium (Group IIA) and Chlorine (Group VIIA).
hints: Ca loses 2 electrons to form Ca^{2+} and each Cl gains 1 electron to form Cl^-.
solution_steps: Ca^{2+} combines with two Cl^- ions to form ionic compound CaCl2.
Step 1: Count total valence electrons from all atoms.
Step 2: Connect peripheral atoms to the central atom and complete octets.
Step 3: Count bonding regions and lone pairs on the central atom to determine shape and polarity.

common_misconceptions.text: Assuming H2O is linear like CO2.
common_misconceptions.correction: Oxygen in H2O has two lone pairs that push the two O-H bonds into a bent shape (104.5 deg), making H2O strongly polar.

Covers Avogadro's number N_A = 6.022e23 mol^-1, molar mass M, molar gas volume V_m = 22.4 L/mol at STP, mass percent composition, determining empirical and molecular formulas, conservation of mass, and balancing chemical equations.

metadata.topic_khmer: ម៉ូល រូបមន្តងាយ និងសមីការគីមី
metadata.subtopic_khmer: ចំនួនអាវ៉ូកាដ្រូ ម៉ាសម៉ូល សមាសភាពភាគរយ រូបមន្តងាយ និងការថ្លឹងសមីការគីមី
metadata.khmer_description: សិក្សាចំនួនម៉ូល ចំនួនអាវ៉ូកាដ្រូ ម៉ាសម៉ូល មាឌម៉ូលឧស្ម័ន ការកំណត់រូបមន្តងាយនិងរូបមន្តម៉ូលេគុល និងការថ្លឹងសមីការគីមី។
metadata.starter_problem: 40\%\text{ C}, \; 6.67\%\text{ H}, \; 53.33\%\text{ O}, \; M = 60\text{ g/mol}, \quad \text{find molecular formula}
learning_objectives: Convert between moles n, mass m, particle count N, and gas volume V
Determine empirical and molecular formulas from mass percentages and molar mass
Balance chemical equations and apply conservation of mass

concepts.title: Mole Conversions & Empirical/Molecular Formulas (ការគណនាម៉ូល និងរូបមន្តម៉ូលេគុល)
concepts.summary: n = m/M = N/N_A = V/V_m; empirical mole ratio n_X : n_Y = (%X / M_X) : (%Y / M_Y).
concepts.body: One mole contains N_A = 6.022e23 particles. Dividing each element's mass (or percentage) by its atomic mass gives the simplest integer ratio (empirical formula). The true molecular formula is (Empirical)_k where k = M_molecular / M_empirical.

khmer_terms.The Mole Concept, Empirical Formulas & C: ម៉ូល រូបមន្តងាយ និងសមីការគីមី
khmer_terms.Avogadro's Constant, Molar Mass, Percent: ចំនួនអាវ៉ូកាដ្រូ ម៉ាសម៉ូល សមាសភាពភាគរយ រូបមន្តងាយ និងការថ្លឹងសមីការគីមី
khmer_terms.Avogadro's constant: ចំនួនអាវ៉ូកាដ្រូ N_A
khmer_terms.molar mass: ម៉ាសម៉ូល M (g/mol)
khmer_terms.empirical formula: រូបមន្តងាយ
khmer_terms.molecular formula: រូបមន្តម៉ូលេគុល

formulas.name: Fundamental Mole Conversions & Mass Percentage
formulas.conditions: V_m = 22.4 L/mol at STP (0 deg C, 1 atm)

examples.problem: An organic compound contains 40.0% C, 6.67% H, and 53.33% O by mass and has molar mass M = 60 g/mol. Find its empirical and molecular formulas.
solution_steps: Step 2: Divide by 3.33: C : H : O = 1 : 2 : 1 => empirical formula CH2O (M_emp = 30 g/mol).
Step 3: Multiplier k = 60 / 30 = 2 => molecular formula C2H4O2.

exercises.prompt: Calculate the number of moles and volume at STP of 11 g of carbon dioxide (CO2, M = 44 g/mol).
hints: Use n = m/M and V = n * 22.4 L/mol.

solution_steps: Step 1: Convert masses or percentages of each element into moles n = m/M.
Step 2: Divide by the smallest mole value to obtain the empirical formula.
Step 3: Use k = M / M_emp to find the molecular formula.

common_misconceptions.text: Altering subscripts inside chemical formulas to balance an equation.
common_misconceptions.correction: Subscripts define chemical identity; only change stoichiometric coefficients in front of formulas.

subject: Chemistry
topic: Inorganic Compounds: Oxides, Acids, Bases & Salts
subtopic: Acidic, Basic & Amphoteric Oxides, Neutralization & Salt Precipitation
text: MoEYS Grade 10 Chemistry Chapter 5: Inorganic Compounds (សមាសធាតុអសរីរាង្គ) — Oxides, Acids, Bases, and Salts. Covers classification and reactions of basic oxides (Na2O, CaO), acidic oxides (CO2, SO2, P2O5), amphoteric oxides (ZnO, Al2O3), and neutral oxides (CO, NO); properties of acids and bases, neutralization reactions Acid + Base -> Salt + H2O, and double-replacement precipitation of salts.

source.section: Acidic, Basic & Amphoteric Oxides, Neutralization & Salt Precipitation

metadata.topic_khmer: សមាសធាតុអសរីរាង្គ (អុកស៊ីត អាស៊ីត បាស និងអំបិល)
metadata.subtopic_khmer: អុកស៊ីតអាស៊ីត អុកស៊ីតបាស អុកស៊ីតអំផូទែ ប្រតិកម្មបន្សាប និងអំបិល
metadata.khmer_description: សិក្សាចំណែកថ្នាក់ នាមវលី និងលក្ខណៈគីមីនៃអុកស៊ីត (អុកស៊ីតបាស អុកស៊ីតអាស៊ីត អុកស៊ីតអំផូទែ) អាស៊ីត បាស និងអំបិល។
learning_objectives: Classify oxides as basic, acidic, amphoteric, or neutral and predict their reactions with water, acids, and bases
Write balanced equations for acid-base neutralization and salt precipitation reactions

concepts.title: Classification & Reactions of Oxides, Acids, Bases & Salts (ចំណែកថ្នាក់ និងប្រតិកម្មនៃសមាសធាតុអសរីរាង្គ)
concepts.summary: Basic oxides react with acids; acidic oxides react with bases; amphoteric oxides (Al2O3, ZnO) react with both.
concepts.body: Soluble basic oxides (Na2O, K2O, CaO, BaO) react with water to form alkalis and with acids to form salt + water. Acidic oxides (SO2, SO3, CO2, P2O5) react with bases to form salt + water. Amphoteric oxides (Al2O3, ZnO) react with both strong acids and strong bases.

khmer_terms.Inorganic Compounds: Oxides, Acids, Base: សមាសធាតុអសរីរាង្គ (អុកស៊ីត អាស៊ីត បាស និងអំបិល)
khmer_terms.Acidic, Basic & Amphoteric Oxides, Neutr: អុកស៊ីតអាស៊ីត អុកស៊ីតបាស អុកស៊ីតអំផូទែ ប្រតិកម្មបន្សាប និងអំបិល
khmer_terms.basic oxide: អុកស៊ីតបាស
khmer_terms.acidic oxide: អុកស៊ីតអាស៊ីត
khmer_terms.amphoteric oxide: អុកស៊ីតអំផូទែ
khmer_terms.neutralization reaction: ប្រតិកម្មបន្សាប

prerequisites: The Mole Concept, Empirical Formulas & Chemical Equations

examples.problem: Write balanced chemical equations showing that aluminum oxide (Al2O3) is amphoteric by reacting it with HCl and with NaOH.
solution_steps: Step 1: With hydrochloric acid: Al2O3 + 6HCl -> 2AlCl3 + 3H2O.
Step 2: With sodium hydroxide: Al2O3 + 2NaOH -> 2NaAlO2 + H2O.

exercises.prompt: What mass of CaCO3 (M = 100 g/mol) precipitates when 0.2 mol of CO2 is bubbled into excess limewater Ca(OH)2?
hints: Reaction: CO2 + Ca(OH)2 -> CaCO3(s) + H2O (1:1 mole ratio).

solution_steps: Step 1: Classify each reactant as oxide (basic/acidic/amphoteric), acid, base, or salt.
Step 2: Predict products using neutralization or ion-exchange rules.
Step 3: Balance atoms and check solubility for precipitates.

common_misconceptions.text: Assuming all metal oxides dissolve in water to form hydroxide bases.
common_misconceptions.correction: Only Group IA and heavier Group IIA oxides (CaO, SrO, BaO) react directly with water; CuO, Fe2O3, and Al2O3 are insoluble in water.

teaching_sequence: Review prerequisites and Khmer MoEYS terminology
Introduce core concept and governing formulas
Walk through step-by-step worked examples on the whiteboard
Check student understanding with guided exercises and misconception checks
